Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: inner tarot card illustration only, to be composited into a fixed card template
Primary request: Create the inner artwork for the Rose Mirror tarot deck card The Fool.
Style: premium mystical editorial, intimate antique mirror ritual, charcoal paper texture, muted rose and rose-gold accents, warm candlelight, soft glass reflections, silk, pearls, dried petals, refined Gen Z spiritual aesthetic.
Card meaning cues: beginnings, trust, freedom.
Deck visual direction: love, antique mirrors, muted rose, emotional boundaries. A young seeker stands before a slightly open oval mirror on velvet, touching the first candlebeam as if entering a new emotional room; rose petals form a small path, the reflection gentle and unresolved. Design inner artwork in a premium mystical editorial tarot portrait ratio, centered composition with generous negative space, charcoal and muted rose atmosphere, champagne candlelight, antique mirror surfaces, rose-gold, silk, and dried petals. No card frame, no border, no title, no numbers, no text, no watermark, no Rider-Waite copy, no celebrity likeness.
Composition: portrait illustration, centered symbolic subject or portrait, generous negative space, no card frame, no border, no title, no numbers, no text, no watermark.
Color palette: charcoal black, deep rose ink, muted rose, ivory highlights, rose-gold and champagne candle accents, moon gray reflections.
Avoid: Rider-Waite copy, celebrity likeness, bright neon colors, horror occult style, cheap romance imagery, text, commercial deck imitation.
